sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate passes deterministic validation and faithfully encodes the verified direct-static requirement: applicability is explicitly branched on the treatment-plant boolean, all required ship-owned approval/compliance facts use the correct values, the ship-to-dischargeDistanceRecords relationship is preserved, and both required nautical-mile quantity properties are constrained on each dischargeDistanceRecords node without imposing an unsupported numerical threshold.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove the redundant generic marpolCertificationStatus and marpolDischargeStatus checks: the verified obligation requires the sewage treatment approval, the specific MARPOL Annex IV 9.1.1-or-9.2.1 certification status, the specific 11.1.2 discharge compliance status, and both discharge distances. Do not impose additional aggregate facts that are not part of that obligation.
